name: Eligibility Checklist for AdSense
author: mimusjobs

sections.description:
Eligibility Checklist for AdSense helps site owners prepare for Google AdSense approval. It provides a dashboard with essential checks (pages, navigation, content quality, SEO titles and mobile readiness) and simple monetized offerings for professional help such as audit reports and article packages.

Key features:
* Site readiness score and detailed checklist
* Essential pages check (Home, About, Contact, Privacy Policy)
* Site-wide content quality metrics (avg words, duplicate snippets, weak posts)
* SEO title checks and mobile friendliness prompt
* Re-run audit via AJAX (admin-only)
* Monetization upsell cards for services

Support

For support and professional customization, email: plugins@mimusjobs.com
sections.installation:
1. Upload the eligibility-checklist-for-adsense folder to the /wp-content/plugins/ directory.
  2. Activate the plugin through the ‘Plugins’ screen in WordPress.
  3. Go to the admin menu “AdSense Checklist” to view the dashboard.
  4. (Optional) If you want to customize styles or JS, edit the files in the assets/ folder packed with the plugin.
sections.faq:
Why does the plugin show a “mobile” info row?

We surface a reminder and a link to Google’s mobile-friendly test. The plugin does not perform a full mobile audit — use the linked Google tool for automated checks.

Can non-admins re-run the audit?

No. Re-running the audit is intentionally restricted to users with manage_options capability.

Are files written to plugin folders at runtime?

No. This plugin does not write files into the plugin directory at runtime. Any packaged assets in assets/ are static and included in the plugin ZIP.
